description: This file contains unit tests for the AccessFlowStateMachineService class, which manages workflow state transitions, actions, and role-based permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It defines test cases for methods such as retrieving allowed actions, next states, or workflow items, as well as updating and deleting workflow records, indicating its focus on verifying service logic in the core workflow module.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior and correctness of AccessFlowStateMachineService methods, including DAO interactions, workflow retrievals, state transitions, and role-based actions within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of the service class and preparing test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineDao.

methods.name: testSetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Tests setting a DAO on the service and retrieving it back, ensuring proper dependency injection.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActions
methods.description: Checks that the service retrieves the correct list of allowed actions for given workflow, state, and role, mocking DAO behavior.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Verifies that the service fetches the expected workflow items based on workflow, state, and role, via mocked DAO responses.

methods.name: testGetNextState
methods.description: Ensures that getting the next state from the service returns expected results or null when no transition exists, using mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Tests that the service correctly retrieves states that are actionable for a set of actions and role within a workflow.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Validates saving a workflow state machine record through the DAO, ensuring the returned object is correct.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion of a workflow state machine record and verifies the boolean success response.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsService
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all workflow state machine records for a specific flow, verifying list size.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedService
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly delegates action allowance checks to DAO and returns expected boolean.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Tests fetching a workflow item by its criteria and compares with expected entity instance.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Checks that workflow records for a user role are correctly deleted and the number of records affected is returned.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Verifies the service correctly delegates user role rename handling and returns expected result.
